name: core-agent
description: OpenAI-compatible LLM backend swappable agent harness (rewrite of antirez/ds4's ds4_agent)

scripts.package:macos: npm run bundle && pkg bundle/cli.cjs --public --targets node20-macos-arm64 --output dist-bin/macos-arm64/core-agent
scripts.package:win: npm run bundle && pkg bundle/cli.cjs --public --targets node22-win-x64 --output dist-bin/windows-x64/core-agent.exe
scripts.package:gui:macos: npm run bundle:gui && pkg bundle/webServer.cjs --public --targets node20-macos-arm64 --output dist-bin/macos-arm64/core-agent-gui
scripts.package:gui:win: npm run bundle:gui && pkg bundle/webServer.cjs --public --targets node22-win-x64 --output dist-bin/windows-x64/core-agent-gui.exe
scripts.package:gui: npm run package:gui:macos && npm run package:gui:win
scripts.package: npm run package:macos && npm run package:win && npm run package:gui
